# TSLink

> TSLink is an open-source CLI and MCP server that gives each app on your computer a private `https://<name>.<tailnet>.ts.net` address, so you or your coding agent can open a running dev server on your phone. Independent project, not made or endorsed by Tailscale. Your phone needs the Tailscale app, signed in to the same tailnet. The agent shares the dev server through MCP or the Claude Code plugin skill, hands back the exact URL and removes the share when you are done. In the default setup each fresh app node needs a person to complete Tailscale enrollment (`needs_login` returns the sign-in link, then `tslink url <name> --wait` returns the exact URL), and a new name can take a while to become reachable. TSLink also gives web apps, folders, files, model APIs and TCP services on a computer or server their own private address, with a private home portal, health checks, alerts and access history. The owner can grant named people access to HTTP and file apps until a deadline, or open an HTTP app to the public internet for a limited time through an expiring browser guest link or Funnel. TSLink requires a Tailscale account. Releases start at v0.1.0: `brew install --cask anydoor7/tap/tslink` on macOS and Linux, Scoop on Windows (`scoop bucket add anydoor7 https://github.com/anydoor7/scoop-bucket` once, then `scoop install anydoor7/tslink`), zip archives as a manual alternative, .deb and .rpm packages on Linux, or a source build.

TSLink does not install or supervise backend apps, isolate workloads on the publishing computer, or replace application login and permissions. It does not enforce per-person access on raw TCP, recall downloaded data, or close already accepted streams when a people grant expires. It does not authorize tools belonging to other MCP servers. Browser guest links can be forwarded and do not verify a person's identity, and a combined multi-computer inventory is not shipped in this version. The Homebrew cask name must stay fully qualified because Homebrew refuses unqualified casks from untrusted third-party taps. Upgrade with `brew upgrade --cask tslink` or `scoop update; scoop update tslink`; if TSLink runs as a background service, run `tslink install` again afterwards. Windows zips are not Authenticode-signed; verify them against the Sigstore-signed checksums.txt. Building from source requires Go 1.27.1+ and Git. Fresh nodes need human enrollment and may need device approval.

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Install with Homebrew, Scoop, a release archive, or from source, and complete enrollment.
- [Sharing and audiences](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/sharing.md): Private, public, HTTP, files, and TCP boundaries.
- [People](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/people.md): Named grants, deadlines, invitations, and revocation.
- [Health and alerts](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/health-and-alerts.md): Backend checks and best-effort alerts.
- [App recipes](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/apps.md): Detect and share apps already running.
- [Agent quickstart](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/agent-quickstart.md): Configure, share, hand off enrollment, verify, and undo.
- [Agents and MCP](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Local tools and result contracts.
- [Remote MCP](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/remote-mcp.md): Opt-in tailnet control and its authority.
- [JSON automation](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/json-automation.md): Versioned results and stable errors.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands and flags; check the installed binary's manifest.
- [Platforms](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): OS requirements and background service behavior.
- [Security](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Trust boundaries and reporting.
- [Choose a sharing tool](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): Dated, primary-source alternatives and trade-offs.
